instruction: I need more time to notice and process notifications. Keep Windows notifications on screen for 5 minutes. This Windows build does not expose the duration control in Settings, so set the current user's `HKCU\Control Panel\Accessibility\MessageDuration` registry value to decimal `300`.
gt_steps: Open Registry Editor or a terminal.
Set `HKCU\Control Panel\Accessibility\MessageDuration` to the DWORD value `300` (decimal).
Verify the value is `300`, which corresponds to 5 minutes.
